default.$description: Translucent neutral overlay — pure white on dark surfaces (brightest greyscale). Default rests at 10% alpha; hover steps up to 20%; active/selected sit at 15%.

hover.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: white at 20% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.

active.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: white at 15% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.

selected.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: white at 15% alpha. Layer it over a surface; used as the only background the element reads as nearly transparent.

default.$description: OVERLAY, not a fill: fully transparent resting state, so the ghost button shows the surface beneath it.
